title: Kendini tanıtma
situation: You meet a new classmate on the first day. Tell them about yourself.
situationTr: İlk gün yeni bir sınıf arkadaşıyla tanışıyorsun. Ona kendinden bahset.

title: Kahve söylemek
situation: You are in a coffee shop. Order something to drink and eat.
situationTr: Bir kahvecidesin. İçecek ve yiyecek bir şeyler söyle.
prompts: What would you like to drink?
Do you want anything to eat?
Is that here or to take away?

usefulPhrases.en: I would like a small one.

title: Ailen hakkında
situation: A friend asks about your family. Talk about the people at home.
situationTr: Bir arkadaşın ailen hakkında soruyor. Evdeki kişilerden bahset.
prompts: How many people are in your family?
Do you have brothers or sisters?
promptsTr: Erkek ya da kız kardeşin var mı?

usefulPhrases.en: I do not have any sisters.

title: Yol sormak
situation: You are lost in a new city. Ask a person in the street for help.
situationTr: Yeni bir şehirde kayboldun. Sokakta birinden yardım iste.

usefulPhrases.en: Excuse me, where is the station?

title: Günün nasıl geçiyor
situation: Your teacher asks about your day. Describe what you do.
situationTr: Öğretmenin, günün nasıl geçtiğini soruyor. Ne yaptığını anlat.
prompts: What time do you get up?
What do you eat in the morning?
When do you go to school or work?
What do you do in the evening?
promptsTr: Okula ya da işe ne zaman gidiyorsun?

usefulPhrases.en: I go to school by bus.
In the evening I watch television.
I go to bed at eleven.

title: Markette alışveriş
situation: You are in a small shop. Buy food for dinner.
situationTr: Küçük bir dükkândasın. Akşam yemeği için yiyecek al.

usefulPhrases.en: I would like some bread, please.

title: Sevdiğin şeyler
situation: A new friend wants to know what you like. Talk about food, music and sport.
situationTr: Yeni bir arkadaş neleri sevdiğini öğrenmek istiyor. Yemek, müzik ve spordan bahset.
prompts: What music do you listen to?

usefulPhrases.en: I listen to music every day.

title: Odanı anlatmak
situation: Your friend has not seen your home. Describe your room.
situationTr: Arkadaşın evini görmedi. Odanı anlat.
prompts: Is your room big or small?

usefulPhrases.en: There is a bed and a table.
usefulPhrases.tr: Bir yatak ve bir masa var.

usefulPhrases.en: The window is behind the bed.

title: Doktora gitmek
situation: You do not feel well. Tell the doctor about the problem.
situationTr: Kendini iyi hissetmiyorsun. Doktora sorunu anlat.

title: Hafta sonu ne yapacaksın
situation: It is Friday. A friend asks about your plans for Saturday and Sunday.
situationTr: Cuma günü. Bir arkadaşın cumartesi ve pazar planlarını soruyor.
prompts: What are you doing on Saturday?

usefulPhrases.en: On Saturday I am going to the park.
I am going with my sister.

title: Saat kaç
situation: You are at the bus stop. A woman asks you the time. Answer her and talk about your day.
situationTr: Otobüs durağındasın. Bir kadın sana saati soruyor. Ona cevap ver ve gününden bahset.
prompts: Say what time your class starts.
Say what time you get up every day.
Ask her when the next bus comes.
promptsTr: Her gün saat kaçta kalktığını söyle.
Ona bir sonraki otobüsün ne zaman geldiğini sor.

usefulPhrases.en: I get up at seven every day.
When does the next bus come?
usefulPhrases.tr: Bir sonraki otobüs ne zaman geliyor?

title: Hava nasıl
situation: Your friend calls you from another city. Talk about the weather where you are.
situationTr: Arkadaşın başka bir şehirden seni arıyor. Bulunduğun yerdeki havadan bahset.
prompts: Say what the weather is like today.
Ask about the weather in her city.
Say what you do when it rains.

usefulPhrases.en: It is cold and sunny today.
I am wearing my black coat.
What is the weather like there?
When it rains, I stay at home.

title: Bir arkadaşını tanıtmak
situation: You are with two friends. They do not know each other. Introduce them.
situationTr: İki arkadaşınlasın. Birbirlerini tanımıyorlar. Onları tanıştır.

usefulPhrases.en: Ayse, this is my friend Emre.
He is a student at my school.
We work in the same office.

title: Bir fotoğrafı anlatmak
situation: You show a photo of your family to a friend. Talk about the people in it.
situationTr: Bir arkadaşına ailenin fotoğrafını gösteriyorsun. Fotoğraftaki kişilerden bahset.
prompts: Say who is in the photo.
Say when the photo was taken.

usefulPhrases.en: This is my mother and this is my brother.
usefulPhrases.tr: Bu annem, bu da erkek kardeşim.

usefulPhrases.en: My brother is playing with the dog.
I am not in this photo.

title: Telefon numaranı vermek
situation: A new friend wants your phone number. Give it to her and ask for her number.
situationTr: Yeni bir arkadaşın telefon numaranı istiyor. Ona numaranı ver ve onunkini iste.
prompts: Say when she can call you.

usefulPhrases.en: My number is five two one three four five six.
usefulPhrases.tr: Numaram beş iki bir üç dört beş altı.

usefulPhrases.en: I am at work in the morning.

title: Otobüs bileti almak
situation: You are at the bus station. You want to go to another city today. Talk to the man behind the window.
situationTr: Otobüs garındasın. Bugün başka bir şehre gitmek istiyorsun. Gişedeki adamla konuş.
prompts: Say where you want to go.
Ask about the time of the next bus.
Ask how much the ticket is.
Say how many tickets you want.

usefulPhrases.en: I want to go to Bursa today.
What time is the next bus?
Where does the bus leave from?

title: Kafede ödeme yapmak
situation: You have finished your tea and cake in a cafe. Now you want to pay.
situationTr: Bir kafede çayını ve pastanı bitirdin. Şimdi ödeme yapmak istiyorsun.
prompts: Ask if you can pay with a card.
Say thank you and say goodbye.
promptsTr: Teşekkür et ve hoşça kal de.

usefulPhrases.en: Can I have the bill, please?
I had a tea and a piece of cake.
usefulPhrases.tr: Bir çay ve bir dilim pasta aldım.

usefulPhrases.en: Can I pay with a card?

title: Evdeki hayvan
situation: A friend asks about the cat in your photo. Talk about the animal in your house.
situationTr: Bir arkadaşın fotoğrafındaki kediyi soruyor. Evindeki hayvandan bahset.
prompts: Say what animal you have and its name.
Say what it does all day.
promptsTr: Hangi hayvanın olduğunu ve adını söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: I have a small cat. Her name is Mia.
usefulPhrases.tr: Küçük bir kedim var. Adı Mia.

usefulPhrases.en: She sleeps all day on my bed.

title: İşe nasıl gidiyorsun
situation: A new friend asks about your morning. Say how you go to work or school.
situationTr: Yeni bir arkadaşın sabahını soruyor. İşe ya da okula nasıl gittiğini anlat.
prompts: Say how you go to work or school.
Say what you do on the way.
promptsTr: İşe ya da okula nasıl gittiğini söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: I go to work by bus.
I listen to music on the way.
Sometimes I walk when it is sunny.
How do you go to work?

title: Bir hediye seçmek
situation: You are in a shop with a friend. You want to buy a present for your mother.
situationTr: Bir arkadaşınla dükkândasın. Annene bir hediye almak istiyorsun.
prompts: Say who the present is for.
Ask your friend what he thinks.
Say how much money you have.

usefulPhrases.en: It is a present for my mother.
What do you think about this one?

title: Sevdiğin yemekler
situation: A friend wants to cook something for you. Talk about the food you like and do not like.
situationTr: Bir arkadaşın sana bir şeyler pişirmek istiyor. Sevdiğin ve sevmediğin yemeklerden bahset.
prompts: Say what you do not like.
Say what you eat for breakfast.

usefulPhrases.en: I do not like fish very much.
For breakfast I eat bread, cheese and eggs.
usefulPhrases.tr: Kahvaltıda ekmek, peynir ve yumurta yiyorum.

usefulPhrases.en: I can cook rice and soup.
I drink tea in the morning.

title: Bir arkadaşı aramak
situation: You call a friend but his mother answers the phone. Say who you are and leave a message.
situationTr: Bir arkadaşını arıyorsun ama telefona annesi çıkıyor. Kim olduğunu söyle ve mesaj bırak.
prompts: Say hello and say who you are.
promptsTr: Merhaba de ve kim olduğunu söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: Can you tell him I called?
I will call again in the evening.

title: Anahtarımı kaybettim
situation: You cannot find your key. You are in front of your building. Talk to your neighbor.
situationTr: Anahtarını bulamıyorsun. Binanın önündesin. Komşunla konuş.
prompts: Say what you will do now.

usefulPhrases.en: I was at school and then at the shop.
My sister has the other key.
I will wait here for an hour.

title: Boş zamanında ne yaparsın
situation: You meet a new person in a language class. Talk about what you do in your free time.
situationTr: Bir dil kursunda yeni biriyle tanışıyorsun. Boş zamanında ne yaptığını anlat.
prompts: Say what you do after work or school.
Say what you do on Sundays.
Say who you do it with.
Ask her about her free time.
promptsTr: İşten ya da okuldan sonra ne yaptığını söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: On Sundays I play football with my friends.
I like reading books at home.
What do you do in your free time?

title: Yarın için plan
situation: You want to go out with a friend tomorrow. Make a plan with him.
situationTr: Yarın bir arkadaşınla dışarı çıkmak istiyorsun. Onunla plan yap.
prompts: Ask if he is free tomorrow.
Say what you want to do.
Say a time and a place.
promptsTr: Bir saat ve bir yer söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: Let us go to the park.
We can meet at two in front of the school.
If it rains, we can go to the cinema.
